

Go side: `TestGolden` in `internal/mdblocks` writes, under `-update`,
`testdata/golden/<name>.blocks.json` for `profile.md` (Task 4) and ten
corpus bodies chosen to include every block type and a `source` block, and
without `-update` compares against them. SPA side:
`web/app/src/editor/contract.test.ts` reads every golden file, creates
`ServerBlockNoteEditor.create({ schema })` from Task 8's schema, converts
the blocks to a ProseMirror document and back
(`_blocksToProsemirrorNode` / `_prosemirrorNodeToBlocks` at 0.56; the test
records the call it used in a comment), and asserts the result equals the
input with `id` stripped and `range`/`offset` preserved.

```ts
for (const file of goldenFiles()) {
  test(`${file} survives BlockNote ${BLOCKNOTE_VERSION}`, async () => {
    const blocks = JSON.parse(await readFile(file, "utf8")).blocks
    const editor = ServerBlockNoteEditor.create({ schema })
    const back = editor._prosemirrorNodeToBlocks(editor._blocksToProsemirrorNode(blocks))
    expect(stripIds(back)).toEqual(stripIds(blocks))
  })
}
```

`BLOCKNOTE_VERSION` is read from `package.json` and the test fails if it is
not `0.56.0`, so a bump is a deliberate edit of this test.
